slices.behaviour: F52: any string literal at any call, under any name, that resolves to a repository file the walk did not collect is reported, so import.meta.glob and the next spelling after it are closed without adding a name to a list. Measured before deciding: an unrestricted inverse gave eight false reports, all directories, and requiring a file removes all eight.
